parts:
> On Aug 26, 2015, at 12:43 PM, Lei Zhang <bnuzhan...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> Hi,
>
> I've encountered the same error message several times, even when I've already set chain=1. After careful debug (mostly by hand), I figured them out.
> In short, I agree with Bob, and several mis-declaration could cause this error. Plus, This error message is really not informative, is it possible to make it more specific in future versions of Stan?

Absolutely --- could you let us know exactly what the error message
was and what you'd like it to say? We want to make these interpretable
to our users.

> Either way, I would share my own experience with this error message.
>
> EX1. beta(a,b) does not allow a (or/and b) = 0
Correct --- it's undefined.
> EX2. x[i]/sum(x) when sum(x)=0, in this case, you could try x[i]/ (sum(x) + machine_precision() )

Divide by zero creates NaN. But you probably do not want to do
x[i] / machine_precision() as that will just produce
roughly 1e15 * x[i], which is probably not what you want.
> EX3. the dimension of your parameters is ill specified

Not sure what you mean here. Our vectorization requires all args to
be either scalars or the same size container.

- Bob
